# Space after section 10

32 KB of 0xFF after section 10, loaded once the section 10 end is raised.

**Category:** free space · **Address:** `0x61478000` to `0x61480000` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

The section 10 end immediate is at 0x60045e24. Nothing references the range in stock.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): All 0xFF in stock with no references. Source: [E-M5 III boot and section loading](../sources/em5n.boot.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Raising the section 10 end and running code here worked on the camera. Source: [E-M5 III memory map](../sources/em5n.memory-map.md).
